name: history-workshop
description: Order events and compare source claims.

interface.longDescription: Order events and compare source claims. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Order historical events; Compare sources on a claim; Check an event sequence. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me compare sources on a claim.

prompts: Help me compare sources on a claim.
Help me check an event sequence.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Source Trail: History workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Order historical events. Reproducible inputs: {"events":[{"year":1789,"title":"Constitution takes effect","source":"Class source A"},{"year":1776,"title":"Declaration adopted","source":"Class source B"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me order historical events with these supplied values: {"events":[{"year":1789,"title":"Constitution takes effect","source":"Class source A"},{"year":1776,"title":"Declaration adopted","source":"Class source B"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses history_workshop_build_timeline with the supplied inputs. Returns {"events":[{"year":1776,"title":"Declaration adopted","source":"Class source B","gap_from_previous":null},{"year":1789,"title":"Constitution takes effect","source":"Class source A","gap_from_previous":13}],"note":"Numeric years are ordered as supplied; historical no-year-zero intervals are not adjusted."}. Shows the actual timeline result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare sources on a claim. Reproducible inputs: {"claim":"The policy was popular.","sources":[{"title":"Letter","author":"A resident","date":"1840","position":"supports","quote":"Our neighbors welcomed it."},{"title":"Editorial","author":"Editor","date":"1840","position":"contradicts","quote":"Many protested the decision."}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare sources on a claim with these supplied values: {"claim":"The policy was popular.","sources":[{"title":"Letter","author":"A resident","date":"1840","position":"supports","quote":"Our neighbors welcomed it."},{"title":"Editorial","author":"Editor","date":"1840","position":"contradicts","quote":"Many protested the decision."}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses history_workshop_source_matrix with the supplied inputs. Returns {"claim":"The policy was popular.","sources":[{"title":"Letter","author":"A resident","date":"1840","position":"supports","quote":"Our neighbors welcomed it."},{"title":"Editorial","author":"Editor","date":"1840","position":"contradicts","quote":"Many protested the decision."}],"counts":{"supports":1,"contradicts":1,"unclear":0},"next_questions":["Are these sources independent?","Whose perspective is missing?"],"note":"Positions are user supplied; source truth is not automatically verified."}. Shows the actual matrix result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Check an event sequence. Reproducible inputs: {"events":[{"year":1918,"title":"Armistice"},{"year":1914,"title":"War begins"},{"year":1919,"title":"Treaty"}]}
positive.prompt: Help me check an event sequence with these supplied values: {"events":[{"year":1918,"title":"Armistice"},{"year":1914,"title":"War begins"},{"year":1919,"title":"Treaty"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses history_workshop_chronology_check with the supplied inputs. Returns {"out_of_order":[{"position":2,"event":"War begins","previous":"Armistice"}],"correct_order":[{"year":1914,"title":"War begins"},{"year":1918,"title":"Armistice"},{"year":1919,"title":"Treaty"}]}. Shows the actual timeline result. Does not fabricate external data.
